title: Gerund, Infinitive, and Conditional Sentence — Level 4 — Find the mistake

items.prompt: Which sentence about the science fair is grammatically correct?

visual.text: We are looking forward to presenting our project.

choices.say: We are looking forward to presenting our project.

visual.text: We are looking forward to present our project.

choices.say: We are looking forward to present our project.

visual.text: We look forward to present our project.

choices.say: We look forward to present our project.

visual.text: We are looking forward present our project.

choices.say: We are looking forward present our project.

items.reteach: Dalam "look forward to", kata "to" adalah preposisi, jadi diikuti gerund: to presenting.

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "She avoided to answer the question because she was not sure."
Find the part that is kurang tepat: "If I had known about the traffic, I would leave home earlier."
items.reteach: Klausa if berbentuk past perfect (type 3), jadi hasilnya would have left.

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "The teacher made the students to rewrite their essays neatly."
items.reteach: Make + objek + bare infinitive: made the students rewrite.

items.prompt: Which sentence about the trip to Banyuwangi is correct?

visual.text: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will climb Ijen.

choices.say: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will climb Ijen.

visual.text: If it won't rain tomorrow, we will climb Ijen.

choices.say: If it won't rain tomorrow, we will climb Ijen.

visual.text: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we would climb Ijen.

choices.say: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we would climb Ijen.

visual.text: If it didn't rain tomorrow, we will climb Ijen.

choices.say: If it didn't rain tomorrow, we will climb Ijen.

items.reteach: Type 1: klausa if memakai simple present (doesn't rain), bukan will; hasilnya will + verb 1.

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "I wish I am taller so I could reach the top shelf."
items.reteach: Wish tentang keadaan sekarang memakai bentuk lampau: I wish I were taller.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses the verb "mind" correctly?

visual.text: Do you mind turning down the music?

choices.say: Do you mind turning down the music?

visual.text: Do you mind to turn down the music?

choices.say: Do you mind to turn down the music?

visual.text: Do you mind turn down the music?

choices.say: Do you mind turn down the music?

visual.text: Do you mind turned down the music?

choices.say: Do you mind turned down the music?

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "Collect old newspapers is our class project this month."
items.reteach: Subjek berupa kegiatan memakai gerund: Collecting old newspapers is …

items.prompt: Which sentence about Raka's plan is correct?

visual.text: Raka has decided to study engineering in Surabaya.

choices.say: Raka has decided to study engineering in Surabaya.

visual.text: Raka has decided studying engineering in Surabaya.

choices.say: Raka has decided studying engineering in Surabaya.

visual.text: Raka has decided study engineering in Surabaya.

choices.say: Raka has decided study engineering in Surabaya.

visual.text: Raka has decide to study engineering in Surabaya.

choices.say: Raka has decide to study engineering in Surabaya.

items.reteach: Present perfect: has + verb 3 (decided), lalu decide + to-infinitive.

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "If he were here, he will help us carry the boxes."
items.reteach: Type 2 (If + were) berpasangan dengan would + verb 1: he would help.

items.prompt: Which sentence about the broken vase is correct?

visual.text: If Rina hadn't played ball inside, the vase wouldn't have broken.

choices.say: If Rina hadn't played ball inside, the vase wouldn't have broken.

visual.text: If Rina hasn't played ball inside, the vase wouldn't have broken.

choices.say: If Rina hasn't played ball inside, the vase wouldn't have broken.

visual.text: If Rina hadn't played ball inside, the vase won't break.

choices.say: If Rina hadn't played ball inside, the vase won't break.

visual.text: If Rina wouldn't have played ball inside, the vase hadn't broken.

choices.say: If Rina wouldn't have played ball inside, the vase hadn't broken.

items.reteach: Type 3: If + had (not) + verb 3, would (not) have + verb 3.

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "My parents let me to stay up late on Saturday nights."
items.reteach: Let + objek + bare infinitive: let me stay.

visual.text: The guide kept telling us to stay on the path.

choices.say: The guide kept telling us to stay on the path.

visual.text: The guide kept to tell us to stay on the path.

choices.say: The guide kept to tell us to stay on the path.

visual.text: The guide kept tell us to stay on the path.

choices.say: The guide kept tell us to stay on the path.

visual.text: The guide kept told us to stay on the path.

choices.say: The guide kept told us to stay on the path.

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "Sinta is proud of win the poetry competition last week."
items.reteach: Setelah preposisi "of" memakai gerund: proud of winning.
